question: Which Indian city served as the venue for the 2019 Indian Open Badminton Tournament?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **2019 Indian Open Badminton Tournament**, officially known as the **Yonex-Sunrise India Open 2019**, was held at the **Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium** located in **New Delhi**.
 
• The tournament took place from **March 26 to March 31, 2019**, and served as the ninth tournament of the **2019 BWF World Tour**.
 
• It was categorized as a **Super 500** event, sanctioned by the **Badminton World Federation (BWF)** and organized by the **Badminton Association of India (BAI)**.
 
• The competition featured five categories: **Men's Singles**, **Women's Singles**, **Men's Doubles**, **Women's Doubles**, and **Mixed Doubles**, with a total prize pool of **$350,000**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Major Winners of 2019 India Open:**

 
 
• **Men's Singles:** The title was won by **Viktor Axelsen** of **Denmark**, who defeated India's **Srikanth Kidambi** in the final.
 
• **Women's Singles:** The title was secured by **Ratchanok Intanon** of **Thailand**, marking her third India Open title.
 
 
 
• **Badminton Association of India (BAI):**
 
 
• It is the governing body for badminton in India, established in **1934** and headquartered in **New Delhi**.
 
• The **India Open** has been a part of the **BWF Super Series** since **2011** and continues to be a premier international sporting event hosted annually in the capital.
 
 
 
• **Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium:**
 
 
• It is the **largest indoor sports arena** in India and the third-largest in Asia, frequently hosting elite global tournaments like the **Thomas Cup** and **Uber Cup**.
